description: This file defines classes and templates related to Netlink messaging within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes classes for handling Netlink parameters, frames, and socket communication, as well as specific implementations for connector types and socket netlink communication. The file references Linux kernel headers and other project-specific modules.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class representing a Netlink message, providing serialization, deserialization, and common properties like type, flags, and sequence.

classes.name: Netlink::Parameters
classes.description: Template class for managing Netlink message parameters, allowing addition of attributes and size calculation.

classes.name: Netlink::Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over Netlink message frames within a received data buffer, providing validation and access to message properties.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific connector Netlink message types, handling acknowledgment and message ingestion.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class for managing a Netlink socket, supporting sending, exchanging, and receiving Netlink messages, with internal message handling.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the current sequence number for the Netlink message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink message.
